subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default, and if so should the canonical surface be `tui.deliver` in `openclaw.json`?
rationale: The missing capability is clear, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and current docs intentionally make delivery an explicit launch-time choice.

options.title: Approve `tui.deliver`
options.body: Add a narrow boolean config default with schema/help/docs/tests, while keeping `--deliver` and any future explicit negation as the highest-precedence override.

options.title: Keep delivery launch-only
options.body: Leave delivery as an explicit per-session flag and close or retitle the request to document that product decision.

options.title: Use session/runtime preference
options.body: Reject a global config key and instead design a TUI-owned persisted preference or settings flow if maintainers want per-session behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve `tui.deliver`
recommendation.body: Add a narrow boolean config default with schema/help/docs/tests, while keeping `--deliver` and any future explicit negation as the highest-precedence override.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is mainly about OpenClaw config/default policy and current blame for the relevant CLI/config surfaces points to this owner signal.
